name: 46849-widespecdecode-qwen3-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1, decode context parallel 1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, bf16; EAGLE3 draft head `AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3`, one decoder layer, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 128 requests / 1800 s safety, with 10% warmup and 10% cooldown.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 1024 (max_tokens with ignore_eos, so no request ends early on a stop token), temperature 0.0, seed 42.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant with draft-model acceleration writing long 1024-token replies for four concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit 1044d19998df96408832b33ccc7120716c615969, served through guidellm's
# `vllm_python` backend. The runtime reader is a FLAT `key: value` line reader that skips indented
# lines, so `speculative-config` MUST stay a single-line JSON flow mapping: a block mapping is
# silently dropped and the engine then starts with no drafter at rc=0.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1}
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 4
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
tensor-parallel-size: 1
# At most 4 x 4096 = 16384 tokens can ever be resident, and KV costs 148 KiB/token
# (2 * 37 layers * 8 kv heads * 128 * 2 B), so the pool this deployment can actually use is
# 2.31 GiB. 0.40 of an 80 GiB card is a 31.7 GiB budget: ~16.0 GiB of weights, ~3 GiB of
# activation peak at 8192 batched tokens, and a ~12.7 GiB KV pool -- still 5.5x more than the
# workload can occupy, so nothing about scheduling, preemption or block allocation changes.
# The engine refuses to start unless that much is FREE at bring-up; asking for 0.85 (67.3 GiB)
# made the run depend on having the card entirely to itself. See configs/note.md.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.40
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
# This engine's `requirements/cuda.txt` pins flashinfer-python 0.6.16.post3, but the venv that
# supplies the compiled extensions carries 0.6.14, and the FlashInfer autotune pass that runs
# during kernel warmup imports a symbol that only exists from 0.6.16 -- so the engine aborts
# before it serves. Nothing in this deployment goes through FlashInfer (dense bf16, no MoE, no
# fp4/fp8, and the attention backend the engine picks here is FlashAttention), so the autotune
# pass has nothing to tune; skipping it also keeps kernel-tactic selection from varying run to
# run. See configs/note.md.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
